info.title: DigiMandal Issues API
info.description: Tenant-isolated issues using existing MySQL, JWT, Mandal membership and private ImageKit storage. Every endpoint requires active membership. Mandal owners and platform admins have no membership bypass. All returned timestamps are UTC. Request examples are illustrative, not seeded production data.

get.description: All Mandals are derived from active membership. Explicit inaccessible mandalId returns 404. LATEST: publishedAt DESC, id DESC. COLLABORATED: issues with your recorded activity first, latest personal activity DESC, publishedAt DESC, id DESC. Activity includes creation, selection, support/un-support, comment changes, edits and resolution. Historical interaction remains after removal. Paging is stable for an unchanged dataset; concurrent activity can move rows between pages. Cards include at most 10 participants and 5 images, with total counts.

delete.summary: Archive an issue as its Mandal administrator
delete.description: Soft archive only. Issue and attached images become inaccessible. No hard delete or reopen API.

put.summary: Replace selected members on a pending issue
put.description: Only admins can assign APPROVER. A creator cannot replace an existing approver list. Member IDs are MandalMember IDs, not User IDs.

put.summary: Acknowledge comments displayed through a timestamp
put.description: Use serverTime from the displayed comments response; timestamps cannot be in the future or move the read watermark backwards.

post.description: Active Mandal admin or designated approver only. The same key, payload and resolver safely replay the original resolution; other attempts return 409. Proof images and at least one solution provider required. Resolution date must be between occurrence and now.

post.summary: Upload a private image for preview or attachment
post.description: One JPEG or PNG up to 5 MiB; verified by decoding, metadata stripped, filename generated. Unattached uploads expire after 24 hours. No arbitrary URLs accepted.
